text.p: Typhoon Zane will be mostly a risk to shipping during the next 24-48 hours. Winds near Zane are about 80 mph at this time and they should still be 60 mph in 24 hours as it moves eastward. It is now east of Yoron island, northeast of Guam. It is expected to pass well south of Honshu during this period. Shipping is at risk due to strong winds and rough seas as the system passes by.

Typhoon Yates, with 90 mph winds, is mainly a risk to shipping as it tracks east of Honshu Japan this period. The system should weaken and become an extratropical storm during the next 24-48 hours. It is currently about 300-350 miles southeast of Tokyo and moving rapidly out to sea.
Tropical Storm Isidore, with 60 mph winds, is centered 1000 miles southwest of the Azores, moving north at 16 mph.
Tropical Storm Genevieve is well southwest of southern Baja with top winds to 40 mph. This system will be a minor risk to shipping as it weakens and dissipates this period.
Tropical depression 11e has formed south of Acapulco. This system is expected to become an increasing risk to shipping as it strengthens and moves towards the northwest this period.
